items.title: Synology NAS devices hit by ransomware via patched DSM flaw
items.summary: Synology is urging customers to update DiskStation Manager after ransomware attacks on its NAS devices, linking to a November 2024 security advisory rather than naming the exploited flaw.

items.title: UK school estate encrypted by 3AM ransomware affiliate
items.summary: Bitdefender reports a 3AM affiliate encrypted about 37 of nearly 50 machines across a UK school estate from an unmanaged host, and suspects AI-generated commands drove part of the intrusion.

items.title: NCSC: AI-built ransomware on UK critical infrastructure 'highly likely'
items.summary: The NCSC's annual State of the Cyber Nation report (3 Nov) warns AI-built malware is highly likely to be used in a ransomware attack on UK critical national infrastructure, possibly within two years.

ransomware.note: Few named November victims disclosed yet; leak-site claims usually lag disclosure by weeks. See ransomware.live for raw claims.

items.title: Monday.com intermittent system availability
items.summary: A third-party tracker showed Monday.com degraded on 4 Nov with an open incident titled 'Intermittent System Availability'.

items.title: Ivanti Cloud ITSM connectivity problems
items.summary: Ivanti's status page confirmed connectivity issues affecting its cloud ITSM environment on 4 Nov, per a community outage thread.

items.title: OpenAI Codex disruption resolved
items.summary: StatusGator logged 58 user reports for OpenAI Codex in the 24 hours to 4 Nov; the service was back to operational by 05:21 UTC.

outage.note: No AWS, Azure or Google Cloud hyperscaler outage reported so far in November; most recent was the GCP europe-west2-b power event on 20 Oct. Items above are from aggregator trackers, not vendor post-mortems.

items.title: CISA adds WordPress Core race condition CVE-2026-119977 to KEV
items.summary: CISA added a WordPress Core time-of-check/time-of-use race condition to the KEV catalog on 3 Nov with a federal remediation due date of 6 Nov.

items.title: CISA alert on PHP unauthenticated RCE flaws CVE-2026-109618/109619
items.summary: CISA warns two PHP vulnerabilities allow unauthenticated remote code execution on PHP systems serving web requests.

items.title: Chainstack discloses infrastructure breach
items.summary: Blockchain infrastructure provider Chainstack disclosed that an unauthorized party gained access to parts of its infrastructure.

items.title: cPGuard update channel hijacked to backdoor Linux servers
items.summary: Attackers hijacked the cPGuard security product's update channel to push backdoors to Linux hosting servers, a software supply-chain compromise.

items.title: Southwest / Four Corners flash flooding forces evacuations
items.summary: Heavy rain sent floodwater across the Southwest, with mandatory evacuations in Pagosa Springs, CO, along New Mexico's San Juan River, and in parts of Sedona, AZ; at least one death.

items.title: Cross-country storm pushes rivers to historic highs across 35 states
items.summary: A large storm system is bringing heavy rain, severe thunderstorms and high-elevation snow to parts of 35 states through next week, with river evacuations and water rescues.

items.title: Florida flooding: state of emergency in seven counties
items.summary: Governor DeSantis declared a state of emergency in seven counties after large-scale water rescues; Brevard Public Schools closed 2–3 Nov.

items.title: Severe flooding across Greece, Rhodes worst hit
items.summary: Extensive flooding and damage were reported across Greece, with the island of Rhodes bearing the brunt.

items.title: Super Typhoon In-fa active in the western Pacific
items.summary: NASA reports Super Typhoon In-fa developed an unusually large eye in a busy Pacific season, while Typhoon Champi's remnants became an extratropical storm aimed at Alaska.

physical.note: USGS significant-earthquake feed returned no events this week.
